headline: Indra Prepares Strategic Plan to 2030 to Boost Stock Performance
summary: Spanish defense and technology firm Indra is presenting its strategic plan through 2030, detailing growth outlooks for its defense, mobility, and Minsait divisions.
why: Indra is Spain's primary defense technology contractor and IT consulting group.

impacts.name: Indra
impacts.why: Unveiling new multi-year targets outlines growth guidance for institutional investors.
